prior_failure: R4E1 tested joint single/double swaps in the registered 16-group neighborhood with matched fixed-h readouts at step2/3 block20; all4 native gates failed. NF2 current-state nonlinear h readouts failed all8 gates. UB2 25/25/50/100 failed supplementary imaging. These finite recipes remain closed.

computation.new_information: Previous complete pre-gate FFN output and projected input from the same request, expert, block and native row coordinate; current post-Q1 input and current outer gate.
computation.hypothetical_operator: Dense FFN anchors at steps0/2; steps1/3 estimate Y_anchor + (h(V1_current)-h(V1_anchor)) B. Real arithmetic notation only; native order must be specified before implementation.
computation.action_family: Whole-M dense anchor or cached-output correction; no support search or bank router.
computation.compensation: A new input-difference low-rank map; not the old fixed-h readout refit. No coefficients fitted here.
computation.native_boundary: Cache complete pre-gate teacher Y. Preserve current attention residual, current gate and native writeback. Reset at request/expert boundary; no reuse of old gated residual.
computation.downstream: Native same-state errors followed by independently exposed candidate trajectories, full FFN timing and fresh-source official video quality; none run here.

substantive_difference: Adds a past complete nonlinear output to the restricted predictor information and changes the main operation from current-input pruning to stateful reuse. Renaming, larger support/rank or another old-state refit is not the proposed distinction.

old_obstruction_scope.established_difference: Pinned observer and metadata identify a full pre-gate nonlinear teacher output not consumed by the old current-h-only readout. Same-expert pairs bind identical raw biases and teacher weight shards.
old_obstruction_scope.what_this_does_not_establish: Extra historical information need not be useful across the large four-step gaps. No closeness, gain, quality, feasibility or novelty is established. The old finite rejection remains valid.
old_obstruction_scope.why_not_eligible: No positive numerical evidence for the new causal hypothesis; metadata confirms sparse matched rows and the strict multi-anchor temporal-difference cold-start obstruction.

falsifiable_prediction: A useful learned input-difference correction must outperform zero-order same-expert pre-gate reuse and frozen UB1 on untouched same-state source pairs under the same native gate; permuting anchor histories should remove any advantage attributed to history. This prediction is untested and no thresholds are registered here.

cheapest_test.completed: CPU metadata alignment audit for all24 sources and40 blocks plus cold-start and storage/MAC arithmetic; no tensor values read.
cheapest_test.result: Only3908 exact native-coordinate pairs across1920 source/block/step-pairs; block20 has58 and55. Existing source-fold training sets have25-33 rows. Every same-expert gate hash differs.
cheapest_test.stop_condition: Stop at data/mechanism readiness if old samples are not a dense paired dataset or online temporal derivatives lack same-expert anchors. Both obstacles are observed for the scoped reuse/derivative ideas. No automatic new collection or fit.
cheapest_test.future_prerequisites_not_a_job_queue: Specify a native implementation/control and a substantive evidence-backed hypothesis, establish matched fresh-source coordinates and cache budget, and independently register any decisive numerical screen before selecting a model route.

cost.auxiliary_cost: Y+h256 caching needs one projection per anchor and two per reuse:3r/(4H) of four dense FFNs=1.388889% at r256,H13824. Full-X caching needs r/(2H)=0.925926%. Quantization, norm, cache traffic and launches extra.
cost.memory: At observed M31668,40 blocks: Y12.0803833GiB; X+Y24.1607666GiB; Y+h25612.6844025GiB. Cache arrays only; not peak or reserved memory.
cost.acceptance: Unchanged50% global main MAC; all auxiliary work reported; measured complete FFN>=1.5x; fresh-source aesthetic/imaging/motion drops each<=2%. No success claimed.

data_exposure: All24 OP2 sources, trajectories and sampled coordinates are development-exposed, including prior baseline fitting. Original20 and supplementary20 are also exposed. No current report is independent final evaluation; a genuinely new frozen final set would be required.
